if( CMAKE_VERSION VERSION_LESS 3.22 )
    message( FATAL_ERROR "The optional raylib benchmark requires CMake 3.22 or newer." )
endif()

set( MOTOR_AI_RAYLIB_SOURCE_DIR "" CACHE PATH "Optional existing raylib source directory" )

# These settings are local to this wrapper; do not change Motor's cache options.
set( BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF )
set( BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF )
set( CUSTOMIZE_BUILD ON )
set( SUPPORT_MODULE_RAUDIO OFF )
set( USE_AUDIO OFF )
set( PLATFORM Desktop )
set( OPENGL_VERSION "3.3" )
set( USE_EXTERNAL_GLFW OFF )
set( GLFW_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF )
set( GLFW_BUILD_TESTS OFF )
set( GLFW_BUILD_DOCS OFF )
set( GLFW_INSTALL OFF )
set( CMAKE_POLICY_DEFAULT_CMP0077 NEW )

if( MOTOR_AI_RAYLIB_SOURCE_DIR )
    if( NOT EXISTS "${MOTOR_AI_RAYLIB_SOURCE_DIR}/src/raylib.h" )
        message( FATAL_ERROR "MOTOR_AI_RAYLIB_SOURCE_DIR must point to a raylib source checkout." )
    endif()
    add_subdirectory( "${MOTOR_AI_RAYLIB_SOURCE_DIR}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/raylib" )
else()
    include( FetchContent )
    if( POLICY CMP0168 )
        cmake_policy( SET CMP0168 NEW )
    endif()
    if( POLICY CMP0135 )
        cmake_policy( SET CMP0135 NEW )
    endif()
    FetchContent_Declare( raylib
        URL "https://codeload.github.com/raysan5/raylib/tar.gz/fdc8b37391b52fdc8cc62af37d02235c9ec59daa"
        URL_HASH SHA256=f0953620e7e384bc1b7885c758b90e21645f4de66efddfb7cca9f5574d01da5d )
    FetchContent_MakeAvailable( raylib )
endif()

foreach( library IN ITEMS raylib glfw )
    if( TARGET ${library} )
        set_target_properties( ${library} PROPERTIES FOLDER "externals/raylib" )
    endif()
endforeach()
